headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 27 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $48.18bn, followed by Base at $5.99bn and Solana at $5.71bn. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest DEX volume at $889m in 24h while Tether generated the top fees at $17.3m. USDT remains the largest stablecoin at $181.85bn circulating with minor 1d contraction; several stablecoins show peg deviations. Base holds the highest L2 TVS at $14.82bn amid multiple recent governance and key compromise incidents.
